title: The Home page, next version — round 2, seventh look

steps.headline: The volume bar is bigger with smaller − and +, carries a see-through speaker showing the level, and bars bounce beside Now playing.
steps.changed: Your notes on the last look. The speaker on the bar shows an X when silent and one, two or three waves as it gets louder, changing while you drag. The bars beside Now playing move while playing and stand still when paused.
steps.notice: The bouncing bars stop entirely when your system asks for reduced motion.
steps.risk: At very low volume the speaker sits on the empty part of the bar, so it switches to the plain text colour to stay visible.
